title: SYNCPOINT and SYNCPOINT ROLLBACK on a non-recoverable KSDS: ROLLBACK backs out nothing the file holds (also in a LINKed program), and a SYNCPOINT ends a READ UPDATE hold

scenarios.summary: READ UPDATE, REWRITE to 0099, SYNCPOINT ROLLBACK, READ: HCSF is not recoverable, the record keeps 0099
READ UPDATE, SYNCPOINT, REWRITE: the syncpoint ended the hold, so INVREQ RESP2 30 and the record is unchanged
REWRITE 0099, LINK to a program that issues SYNCPOINT ROLLBACK, READ in the caller: 0099 stays, the caller goes on
